title: Get lost in Meow Wolf’s Santa Fe house

location.label: Meow Wolf: House of Eternal Return, Santa Fe

description: Enter an ordinary-looking house at Meow Wolf’s House of Eternal Return and begin opening doors. Its rooms branch into strange, colorful environments made by artists, with clues to a story you can follow or simply wander past. There is no single prescribed route, so curiosity becomes your guide from one surprise to the next.
teaser: Open doors into the unexpected at House of Eternal Return.
goodToKnow: Walking, sensory effects and varied routes; ask about the most manageable accessible visit.
whyItMightDelightYou: You can choose how deeply to investigate the mystery, making the visit feel like your own discovery.
